_comment: icraft #56: relocate pridestructure arena ['snowy_plains', 'snowy_taiga', 'snowy_beach'] -> #minecraft:is_nether for tier-fit. Cardinal Sins escalates (7 sins -> Lucifer -> Drakara) but every arena was overworld, so location-tiering wrongly flattened them to T1. Now: lesser sins -> Undergarden (T2-T3), fierce sins + Drakara -> Nether (T3), Lucifer -> Nether + a T4 gate (milestone TIER_4_BOSSES). Overrides the mod's forge:add_features biome modifier (same datapack path -> last-loaded wins). NOTE raw_generation feature-placed arena: verify it lands cleanly in the new dimension's terrain.
